Theorem
[Green's formulas] ↗ thm:integration-by-parts-formula ↗ def:outward-normal-and-normal-derivative 1. appC:thm-3\group Gauss-Green Theorem

If $u,v\in C^2(\overline U)$, then \[ ext{(i)}\qquad \int _U\Delta u\, dx =\int _{\partial U} rac{\partial u}{\partial u }\, dS, \] \[ ext{(ii)}\qquad \int _UDv\cdot Du\, dx =-\int _Uu\Delta v\, dx +\int _{\partial U}u rac{\partial v}{\partial u }\, dS, \] and \[ ext{(iii)}\qquad \int _U(u\Delta v-v\Delta u)\, dx =\int _{\partial U} \left(u rac{\partial v}{\partial u } -v rac{\partial u}{\partial u } ight)\, dS. \]
Proof

\sketch Apply (2) to $u_{x_i}$ with the second factor $1$ and sum over $i$ to obtain (i). Apply (2) componentwise to $v_{x_i}u$ and sum to obtain (ii). Interchange $u$ and $v$ in (ii) and subtract to obtain (iii).

□
